title: lore sync logs a commit whose only bundle change is the generated log.md, so the log never reaches a fixed point
description:
Filed under opum-doc ruling DEC-172 (4bq), routed by opum-agent. The ruling is at opum-doc origin/dev 1777d64 (commit "chore(ODOC-434): DEC-172 (4bq), lore sync does not log a log.md-only commit (#908)"), .quest/planning.json. Tracker-only filing; not started.

The defect: `lore sync` always adds a log entry for the latest commit that touched the docs, so `docs/log.md` is always one entry behind, and a commit that only updates the log earns yet another entry — the log never reaches a fixed point, and every repository carries a permanently pending log diff or a ritual follow-up commit.

Cause, verified this session on lore-cli origin/dev 469153d8 (read, not relayed):
- `foldersTouched` (src/core/log.ts:498) adds a folder for every file satisfying `isUnderRoot(file, root)` (:501; `isUnderRoot` at :533 is `file.startsWith(`${root}/`)`), i.e. every file under the bundle root.
- The generated log lives at `<root>/log.md`. That path starts with `${root}/`, so it is counted; its immediate parent is the root itself, so a log.md-only commit yields a non-empty folder set `{root}`.
- `generateLogWithStats` (:269) assigns any commit with a non-empty folder set to its deepest common folder, so a log.md-only commit is emitted as an entry. The commit that records the log is therefore itself a docs commit that earns a fresh entry on the next sync.
- Nothing in `foldersTouched` or its callers excludes `log.md`; a grep of src/core/log.ts finds no such exclusion.

Ruling (binding on lore-cli), which is this task's scope:
- `foldersTouched` excludes the bundle's own generated `<root>/log.md`. A commit that touches nothing else under the root gets NO entry, and a commit that touches log.md alongside real docs is logged exactly as today, by its other paths.
- index.md is NOT excluded: it changes only with concept changes, which are real docs changes.
- Proved both ways (see acceptance criteria).
- Already-committed entries for past log-only commits are kept; the carry-forward merge never drops recorded history, so no rewrite is wanted.

Until this ships, the reporting session's practice stands: leave the pending log entry to ride the next real docs change; `lore check` exempts log.md from its drift gate (ADR-0007), so that is safe.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `foldersTouched` excludes the bundle's own generated `<root>/log.md`: a commit whose only change under the root is log.md produces NO log entry, while a commit that touches log.md alongside other bundle files is logged exactly as today, by its other paths. index.md is NOT excluded.

Proved BOTH ways, each with a recorded run: (a) a real docs commit followed by a log-only commit leaves `lore sync` with no diff (a fixed point is reached); (b) with the exclusion removed, the same sequence produces a new entry; (c) a mixed commit (log.md plus a concept) is still logged.
Already-committed entries for past log-only commits are kept unchanged: the carry-forward merge drops no recorded history, and no existing log.md history is rewritten.

plan: Exclude the bundle's own generated <root>/log.md inside foldersTouched (src/core/log.ts:498) so a log-only commit contributes no folder and earns no entry, while a mixed commit (log.md plus a concept) is still logged under its other paths, and index.md stays included. Prove both ways in test/log.test.ts: generateLog over [docs-commit, log-only-commit] is byte-identical to generateLog over [docs-commit] alone (fixed point); with the exclusion reverted the same pair adds an entry; a mixed commit still logs. Past entries are untouched (carry-forward merge, no rewrite).
implementationNotes:
Implemented LCLI-711 (DEC-172 (4bq)). src/core/log.ts: foldersTouched now excludes the bundle's own generated `<root>/log.md` (new module const LOG_FILE), so a commit whose only bundle change is log.md contributes no folder set and generateLogWithStats emits no entry for it; a commit that touches log.md alongside real docs is logged by its other paths; index.md stays included. It is one exclusion inside the existing foldersTouched, not a second mechanism.

Both-ways proof (AC2), MEASURED, not predicted:
- GREEN with the fix: `bun test test/log.test.ts test/sync.test.ts` 112 pass / 0 fail (was 104/0; +8 unit tests, +1 sync-level test).
- RED without it: the exclusion removed from foldersTouched (the exact pre-fix shape, temporary mutant), same two files -> 107 pass / 5 fail. The 5 failing tests are exactly: "a commit whose only bundle change is log.md contributes no entry"; "the log reaches a fixed point: [docs, log-only] is byte-identical to [docs] alone"; "a mixed commit (log.md plus a concept) is still logged, by its other paths"; "a sync over [docs, log-only] with the log already written reports nothing added"; and the sync-level "LCLI-711: a log-only commit leaves sync with no diff". Positive controls (index.md included; out-of-root log.md ignored) pass BOTH ways.
- AC2(a) is proved end-to-end at the sync level (test/sync.test.ts, inside "log.md is a full-history projection"): the first sync writes the log for the docs commit; a log-only commit is then in history; the second sync reports docs/log.md ABSENT from report.files and the file is byte-identical; with the exclusion removed the same sequence adds an entry and docs/log.md is rewritten (the RED above).

AC3: a committed entry for a log-only commit is carried forward verbatim and re-syncing over its own output is byte-stable ("a committed entry for a log-only commit is kept, not rewritten"); no past entry is rewritten.

Interpretation note for opum-doc (flagged to the leader; not a defect): the mechanism ("foldersTouched excludes <root>/log.md") means a mixed commit's folder follows its OTHER paths, so a commit touching log.md plus a subfolder concept now renders under that concept's folder rather than the root folder the log.md path used to drag it to. That is exactly "by its other paths", and is pinned by a test; raising it only so the "exactly as today" wording is read as intended.

Gates: `bun run typecheck` exit 0; `bun run lint` exit 0 (12 pre-existing warnings, 1 info); `bun test` 5017 pass / 2 skip / 0 fail; `bun run lore check` exit 0 (89 files, 0 errors, 1 pre-existing portability warning).
finalSummary: lore sync no longer logs a commit whose only bundle change is the generated log.md (DEC-172 (4bq)): foldersTouched (src/core/log.ts) excludes the bundle's own `<root>/log.md`, so a log-only commit earns no entry and the log reaches a fixed point, while a mixed commit is still logged by its other paths and index.md stays included. Proved both ways: GREEN 112 pass/0 fail on test/log.test.ts + test/sync.test.ts, RED 107 pass/5 fail with the exclusion removed (the exact pre-fix shape), the 5 reds being exactly the log-only/mixed/fixed-point tests; AC2(a) proved end-to-end at the sync level (second sync leaves docs/log.md byte-identical and absent from report.files). No rewrite of past entries (carry-forward kept). Gates: typecheck 0, lint 0, bun test 5017 pass/2 skip/0 fail, lore check 0.
